Subject: App integration quick reference — SDK samples & retry guidance

Hi Tom / NovaCorp team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. I put together a compact reference to help your devs go from SDK install to a safe endpoint migration. Attaching a short PDF (bridge_quickref_v1.pdf) and a runnable sample client (sample_client.py). Highlights below so your engineers can scan quickly: 

- SDK setup: use the official Node/Python packages (npm: @redwood/inference, pip: redwood-inference). Prefer pinned minor versions during cutover (e.g., 1.4.x).
- Endpoint migration: start with a canary route (5-10% traffic) routed to Redwood Dedicated; keep legacy endpoint as fallback for 72 hours. Validate token TTL and CORS preflight behavior.
- Retries & timeouts: client-side timeout = 60s for streaming calls, overall request timeout = 120s. Retry only idempotent calls for 429/503 with jittered exponential backoff.
- Rate limit handling: read 429 Retry-After header; implement queueing with token-bucket at the SDK layer for steady bursts.
- Observability: send request_id and include x-redwood-model headers; enable token and latency breakdowns in the Console for first 48 hours.

Next steps: can we get a short sample traffic profile (rps, typical seq len) before our tech sync? I'm proposing a 30-minute engineering check on Wed 17 Jun (10am PT).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
